item.title: Introduction
item.description:
Hi, I am Do June.

This is the first post for my blog, which will feature articles presenting and explaining some of the works that I did, either for school or independently.

I’m also planning to post my thoughts on the fields that I am interested in, which you can find here.

Don’t forget to check out my portfolio.

Feel free to contact me through email. You can also leave comments below individual posts.
